Good restaurant near Lao Cai train station
Oct 2024 • Couples
This restaurant is located directly across from the train station in Lao Cai, Vietnam. Many of the trains that leave Lao Cai travel at night to Hanoi, so this restaurant is used to train travelers coming in with their baggage and hanging out until it is time to get the train. Food is delicious! And they also have excellent WiFi so that you can do work or just be on the internet while you wait. Very helpful staff.

Convenient and hospitable!
Aug 2021 • Family
Visited MY 2019. We had breakfast here when we got off the overnight train from Hanoi...and lunch and dinner before the return trip, after a 4-day sojourn in Bac Ha. Conveniently located across the road from the train station, the food and juices were fine and the staff super-friendly and helpful. They provided taxi transport to our accommodation in Bac Ha (with a side-trip to see the border crossing with China open at 7am at our request before leaving town), let us leave our luggage on the premises while we had a look around town while waiting for our return rail journey to Hanoi, and genuinely loved interacting with our 3 year old son. Lovely people.

A good place to wait for your train
Nov 2019 • Family
We arrived at Lao Cai early for our overnight train to Hanoi. Having two hours to spend, we searched for a restaurant near the train station. 
This place is directly opposite the train station across the car park. The sign is lit and visible from the train station. 

Inside, there are a lot of backpackers and travellers. The staff are hospitable and offer you a place to place your luggage. We ordered 3 beef pho which came quickly and a grilled chicken that took a little while. The Vietnamese food was decent. However, the tomato juice did not look or taste like tomato juice. 

It is a very good place to hang out and wait for the train. It feels like the unofficial ‘train lounge’ packed with travellers.
